correctness.rationale: Four mutually orthogonal Laplacian projectors have eigenvalues 0, b(pt+q), bp, b(p+q). Exact rational projectors yield the three offdiagonal entry identities. Positive denominators and F(z)>0 prove diagonals positive, and the clique offdiagonal quadratic has positive terms precisely when qt≤p+2q. Above that threshold its leading coefficient is negative while the other coefficients are positive, implying exactly one positive sign crossing. The replayed SymPy verifier confirms rational identities and 384 exact full-matrix and 108 negative-witness cases, supplemental to the proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural network family has a sharp p/q-dependent boundary for all-step preservation of nonnegative heat states. Beyond it, making clique connections too strong yields a unique explicit time of sign loss despite classical A-stability and exact continuous-time positivity. The threshold is structural and has a nontrivial infinite parameter dependence; it is not an arbitrary small instance or merely a re-expression of the eigenvalues.
